content.text:
Shipyard, Tavern and Market
arrive in Phase 5

events.comment: PORT (Phase 1 stub). Full harbor with Shipyard/Tavern/Market is Phase 5.

SAILING SCENE -- logic lives in external events, one per manager.
VoyageManager: voyage state machine, distance, ocean scroll, sinking.
EncounterManager: spawning, approach, decisions, outcomes.
UIManager: layout, HUD, buttons. Buttons only record Sailing.PendingAction;
managers act on it next frame. Order matters: UI last.

VOYAGE STATE MACHINE. Voyage.State holds exactly one of:
PORT, SAILING, ENCOUNTER_APPROACH, ENCOUNTER_DECISION, COMBAT, BOARDING,
PARLEY, TRADE, EVENT, REWARDS, RETURNING, SUNK.
Change state ONLY by setting Voyage.State and resetting Voyage.StateTime to 0.
Phase 2 uses: PORT, SAILING, ENCOUNTER_APPROACH, ENCOUNTER_DECISION, PARLEY,
COMBAT (quick roll until Phase 3), REWARDS (outcome screen), RETURNING, SUNK.

events.name: Voyage start (new voyage every time this scene opens)
State timer (seconds spent in current state, frame-rate independent)
STATE: SAILING
STATE: RETURNING (ship slows, then the Port scene opens)

events.comment: Phase 5 will bank Voyage.Gold / cargo into Player here before leaving.

events.name: ENCOUNTER STATES: ships slow down alongside each other
STATE: SUNK (hull reached 0: lose unbanked gold, keep permanent progress)

parameters: "Unbanked gold lost: " + ToString(Voyage.Gold) + NewLine() + "Your ships and upgrades are safe."

events.name: Ocean scroll (eases toward ScrollTarget; offsets wrap to stay small)

events.comment:
RESPONSIVE LAYOUT. Game uses 'scaleOuter': the 720x1280 reference is always
fully visible, taller phones get extra height, tablets get extra width.
Everything is positioned from SceneWindowWidth/Height, and recomputed only
when the window size changes (not every frame).
Settings.SafeTop/SafeBottom reserve space for notches / home indicators.

events.name: Layout (on start and on resize)
Ship idle motion (rocking + bobbing, time-based)
HUD refresh (5x per second, not every frame, to avoid re-rendering text)

parameters: "Hull " + ToString(Enemy.Hull) + "    Crew " + Enemy.Approx + ToString(Enemy.EstCrew) + "    Cannons " + Enemy.Approx + ToString(Enemy.EstCannons)
"They will sail on in " + ToString(ceil(Config.DecisionTimeout - Voyage.StateTime)) + "s"

events.name: Encounter UI: visibility + banner
HUD buttons (UI only records the choice; managers act on it next frame)

events.comment:
ENCOUNTER MANAGER. One encounter at a time: the spawn timer only runs while
SAILING with no other ship present (Enemy.Active = 0). A single EnemyShip
instance is reused for every encounter (no create/delete per encounter).
Encounter types are data in the global EncounterTypes structure.

events.name: Setup
Spawn timer + weighted encounter generation

events.comment: Pass 1: total weight (weights shift with distance tier).
Pass 2: walk the list until the roll is used up.
Some information is approximate: hostile captains hide their strength.

events.name: Enemy ship motion (time-based)

events.comment: Departures play after the outcome, once back to SAILING.
Ship fully gone: free the slot and schedule the next encounter.

events.name: Decision timeout (pirates attack, others sail on)
Flee chance (shown on the Flee button)
Player decisions (from Sailing.PendingAction)
PARLEY outcome (weighted; full dialogue options come in a later phase)

parameters: "The " + Enemy.Name + " pays" + NewLine() + ToString(GoldGain) + " gold for safe passage."
"The captain of the " + Enemy.Name + NewLine() + "wishes you fair winds."
"The " + Enemy.Name + " refuses" + NewLine() + "to talk and sails on."
"You hand over " + ToString(GoldGain) + " gold." + NewLine() + "The " + Enemy.Name + " lets you pass."
"The " + Enemy.Name + " honours" + NewLine() + "the code and sails off."

events.name: COMBAT (Phase 2 quick resolution; Phase 3 replaces this with cannon combat)

parameters: "You sank the " + Enemy.Name + "." + NewLine() + "+" + ToString(GoldGain) + " gold    -" + ToString(DamageTaken) + " hull" + NewLine() + "Cannonballs used: " + ToString(ShotsUsed)
"The " + Enemy.Name + " out-gunned you." + NewLine() + "-" + ToString(DamageTaken) + " hull    no plunder" + NewLine() + "Cannonballs used: " + ToString(ShotsUsed)

events.name: Frame end: the pending button action has been handled
